title: City Advances Plan to Implement New State Law that Encourages More Homes Near Transit
description:
A new state law that encourages more homes near transit is set to take effect on July 1, and the City is working on a plan to implement it in a way that makes sense for San Diego. Community input will play a key role in shaping the plan. 

The law requires cities to approve certain housing projects within a half mile of qualifying transit stops. The City will phase implementation in certain areas — such as very high fire severity zones and areas impacted by sea level rise — which means it will not take effect on July 1. This provides additional time to develop a thoughtful plan tailored to San Diego’s unique needs. In some areas, the law will take effect immediately.

Learn more about the law, the City’s approach and how to stay updated on opportunities to provide feedback: insidesandiego.org/city-advances-plan-implement-new-state-law-encourages-more-homes-near-transit
